text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has finally come to an
end...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Another year, another productive
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes... Very funny. That is not what I meant, and you know it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Although... I'd be lying if I said I wasn't grateful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is right around
the corner.
We must keep our resolve
firm and—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I suppose I should never have
doubted
you.
choice_data_list: しっかりついていくよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll make sure to keep right up with you.
